datasets.title: Hospital Authority blood-culture non-susceptibility
datasets.unit_of_observation: Year × organism × antimicrobial × onset setting, blood culture

scope_note.rounding: Patient headcounts are rounded to the nearest 100. Percentages and confidence limits are retained at source precision; they are not recalculated from rounded counts.
scope_note.suppression: The source symbol § identifies a positive patient count below 50; its numeric field is null and its literal symbol is retained.
scope_note.coverage: A †† suffix marks AST coverage below 70%. Absence of the suffix is stored as not_flagged, without estimating an exact testing percentage.
scope_note.deduplication: The source de-duplicates with location of onset considered. A patient can contribute an isolate to each onset group when available.
scope_note.confidence_intervals: The source reports Wilson 95% confidence intervals. An inequality at a confidence bound is stored separately from the numeric boundary.
scope_note.small_denominator: The report excludes non-susceptibility percentages based on fewer than 10 de-duplicated isolates. No result rows are invented for absent cells.
scope_note.metric: The metric remains the official non-susceptibility percentage. The checked key-findings PDF does not separately enumerate R and I categories; no R-only or I+R relabelling is imposed.
scope_note.scope: This PDF supplies E. coli hospital-onset records and K. pneumoniae community- and hospital-onset records. E. coli community-onset rows are not present in this file.

third_party_terms.attribution: Source: Centre for Health Protection / Hospital Authority, Hong Kong SAR Government. Source rights remain with the Government and other owners.
third_party_terms.distribution_scope: Structured factual statistics and provenance are extracted. The source PDF, figures, layout and explanatory prose are not redistributed; the application MIT licence does not cover source material.
third_party_terms.notice_scope: The CHP notice permits complete unmodified copies for personal/internal non-commercial use. It does not establish a general open-data licence for this adapted extract.
